summary: Manifest resolves libsignal from an unpinned personal GitHub repository
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node`, a personal GitHub repository reference with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever that external account's default branch currently contains and runs any lifecycle scripts it carries inside the installer's environment. The dependency source is off-registry and mutable: the account owner can change the tree at any time without a new publish of @poucode/baileys, so the code that executes on install is not controlled by the published package version. The package name is a lookalike of the widely used `@whiskeysockets/baileys` WhatsApp library, which expands the pool of installers exposed to the unpinned external reference.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
